title: Rabbi Bana’ah, Brother of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Ketubot 50b: orphans’ movable property was in his hands, and they came before Shmuel. Hyman identifies him as Ravnai, the brother of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba; see his entry.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Ketubot 50b writes Rabbi Bannai, brother of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba. Hyman’s heading has Bana’ah and his cross-reference identifies him with Ravnai; these forms and Hyman’s identification remain distinct.
The identification with Ravnai and the cross-reference are Hyman’s; the different supplied forms are preserved.
